 The Hon'Ble Smt. Justice G. Anupama Chakravarthy

entities.text: V. Vijay Kumar vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure (for short 'Cr.P.C.')
by the petitioners - accused Nos.1 to 4 to quash FIR No.415 of 2023 on the file of the Station House Officer, Miyapur Police Station, Cyberabad.

The offences alleged against the petitioners are under Sections 420 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code (for short 'IPC').
2.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri S.Ganesh, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1 - State.
3. It is contended by learned counsel for the petitioners that petitioner Nos.1 and 2 - accused Nos.1 and 2 have already received notice under Section 41-A Cr.P.C.
It is further contended by learned counsel for the petitioners that the dispute between the parties is purely civil in nature but it was converted into a criminal case.
Therefore, he prayed to quash the proceedings against the petitioners.

4. On the other hand, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor contended that it is not a fit case to quash the proceedings against the petitioners at this juncture, as the investigation is not yet completed.

Taking into consideration that the punishment prescribed for the offences alleged against the petitioners is less than seven (07) years imprisonment and petitioner Nos.1 and 2 - accused Nos.1 and 2 have already received notice under Section 41-A Cr.P.C., this Court deems it appropriate to direct petitioners No.3 and 4 - accused Nos.3 and 4 to appear before the investigating officer on or before 30.09.2023 between 02:00 p.m. and 04:00 p.m.

The Investigating Officer is directed to follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A Cr.P.C and also the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, petitioners No.3 and 4 - accused Nos.3 and 4 shall co-operate with the Investigating Officer as and when required by furnishing information and documents as sought by him in concluding the investigation.

Further,
petitioners No.3 and 4 - accused Nos.3 and 4 are directed not to threaten or influence any of the witnesses in this case.
6. With the above directions, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
